profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Coverys
profile.summary:
•	Experience in all phases of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from Requirements gathering, Analysis, and Design, Development, Documentation, Testing, Implementation and Maintenance of various Web and windows applications in Waterfall and Agile Methodology.
•	Focus on helping client to define strategic road map for new technology adoption, align their business goal with technical needs and stream line their technology stack.
•	Experience has been focused on Microsoft Technology and has expertise in developing Web based applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET Core, Web API, RESTful services, Web Forms, REST API, WCF, LINQ, Entity Framework, JavaScript, JQuery, JSON, CSS, HTML, Angular, Bootstrap.
•	Experience in azure cloud-based development with App service, cloud service, Logic App, API Management, Azure storage, Service Bus and application Insights.
•	Knowledge on Design Patterns, Data Structure and Algorithms.
•	Experience in RDBMS Concepts, Data Mapping, Table normalization, Data Modeling and SSIS Package.
•	Expert in Database design and development and experience in writing SQL queries, Views, Triggers, Stored Procedures, Cursors, and Joins in SQL Server.           
•	Team Player with Focused/Committed / Get-the-Job-Done Attitude, highly organized and able to work independently.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and Developed a self-service portal, which provides an easy-to-use interface for the client’s customers to take required action (ex. Equipment return, parts exchange, etc.) utilizing responsive web design. 
• Responsible for working with 3rd party vendors in integrating OPT’s dispatch management platform with their systems using REST-based API’s.  
• Implemented Mail Carrier Automation (MCA) service that provides real-time shipment tracking and status updates on returns for client’s that have a high volume of equipment or product being shipped or return. 
• Created an internal web application to customize various automation services for each client’s specific needs (i.e., carrier, schedule, business rules). 
• Integrated Client’s Salesforce in order to feed data interactively into OPT’s SSCO (Service Supply chain Optimization) platform. 
• Prototyped microservices sample that demonstrated the use of Azure API management. 
• Involved in Analysis, Database Designing, implementation, and testing of contact strategy application utilizing Azure cloud service, Azure storage, Azure Cosmo DB, and service bus. 
• Implement NUnit Testing, Integration Testing, Functional UI Testing, and Regression Testing.

positions.title: SharePoint/.Net Consultant
positions.description: International Shared Services: The intranet portal supports the shared service in the global bank expansion project. The intranet portal will enable internal bank users to view and maintain data associated with all the Shared Services (bank look up, calendar and cut off time, Global payment system) along with supporting the maintenance of internal bank operator entitlements.

positions.title: SharePoint/.Net Consultant
positions.description: Public disclosure Request (PDR) Application: PDR System is used by the Biogen Idec Research and Development; and PO&T organizations for the review and approval of business or scientific information prior to its disclosure to the public. PDR application will provide better search functionality; enable selection of approvers rather than tying the approver information with selected projects, provide delegation functionality and reduce manual intervention.

positions.title: Sharepoint Consultant
positions.description: Infopedia: Infopedia is a search dictionary for Cardinal’s internal users. It combines business definitions, technical definitions, and report terms using Google Search Appliance.
